statement: For every prime p congruent to1 modulo4, the actual degree-p^3 exponent-p Heisenberg cover z^p=psi_p(x), of genus1+p^2(p-1)/2 and p^2 cusps, satisfies both TaskA.5 assertions at every coefficient prime and permitted packet. Together with A61 this completes the family for every odd p.
depends_on: A.61 exact division differential and actual deck-group argument
answers: Task A.5: both assertions for the full odd-prime Heisenberg family, uniformly in the prime
notes: Registered after complete independent root and PBC proof/source/code audits PASS. Exact certificate at p=5,13,17 checks actual division functions, the full Verschiebung curve identity and rational differential pullback, every critical multiplicity and genus. Over an unramified Gauss DVR, the actual characteristic-zero translation identity normalized modulo p^2 makes the divided differential descend through the separable CM isogeny. Its descended function has one pole of orderp and derivative mu*x, so exactly one triple and p-3 simple zeros. Actual charts yield p degree4 tails and p(p-3) degree2 tails, with an ordinary elliptic main component; the genus sum proves compact type. The p^2 cusps form p rational clusters ofp marks away from all tails. A42 gives full fixed inertia at every coefficient prime and packet; A59 gives all normalizers. Together A61/A62 settle the full odd-prime Heisenberg family uniformly. The family is not claimed cofinal; universal TaskA.5 remains Open.
